T: The last harvest is corn. Make it count.
D: Astronauts travel through a wormhole to find a new home for humanity.
P: Serve the snacks when Cooper and Donald sit on the porch with a beer.
S: Last crop corn on the cob
the farms where corn is the only crop left
Corn cobs boiled 6 minutes, brushed with butter mixed with smoked paprika and lime, charred on a hot grill and sprinkled with salt and grated parmesan.
the dust storms that roll over the farm
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter, smoked paprika and brown sugar until every kernel is dusted, poured into bowls on the porch.
Cooper and Donald's beers on the porch
Soft pretzel bites boiled briefly in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked at 220C for 12 minutes, served with a cheese sauce made with beer and cheddar.
M: dinner at the farmhouse table with Murph and Tom
Chicken thighs poached, shredded and folded into a creamy sauce with corn, leek and thyme, topped with shortcrust pastry and baked at 200C for 30 minutes until golden.
Pork shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and salt, roasted at 160C for 4 hours, the crackling blasted at 240C, with roast potatoes and apple sauce.
W: the corn farm before Cooper leaves
Sweet, custardy buttermilk pie with nutmeg, the simplest farmhouse dessert there is. Whisk 3 eggs, 250g sugar, 60g melted butter, 2 tbsp flour, 250ml buttermilk, vanilla and nutmeg.
K: the beer on the porch at dusk
Cold lager in frosted glasses, or a non-alcoholic option of iced tea with lemon on the farmhouse porch.

s.n: Last crop corn on the cob
s.note: the farms where corn is the only crop left
s.how: Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes. Brush with 50g butter mixed with 1 tsp smoked paprika and lime zest, then char on a hot grill. Sprinkle with salt and 30g finely grated parmesan.

s.note: the dust storms that roll over the farm
s.how: Pop 120g popping corn in 2 tbsp oil. Toss straight away with 50g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp brown sugar until every kernel is dusted. Pour into bowls on the porch.

m.note: dinner at the farmhouse table with Murph and Tom
m.how: Poach 800g chicken thighs and shred. Soften a sliced leek in butter, add 2 tbsp flour, 200ml stock and 200ml cream, then the chicken, 200g corn kernels and thyme. Tip into a dish, top with 2 sheets shortcrust and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: the corn farm before Cooper leaves
w.how: Whisk 3 eggs, 250g sugar, 60g melted butter, 2 tbsp flour, 250ml buttermilk, vanilla and nutmeg. Pour into a 23cm blind-baked shortcrust case and bake at 170C for 45 minutes until just set. Cool before slicing.

d.note: the beer on the porch at dusk
d.how: Chill four 375ml bottles of lager and frost four glasses in the freezer. For anyone not drinking, brew 4 black tea bags in 1L water, chill and pour over ice with lemon. Sit on the porch and watch the dust.
